query_analysis.original_query: We are looking to develop a more energy-efficient approach to extract ethanol from a 95% azeotropic mixture. Any suggestions on alternative distillation or hybrid methods?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate and propose energy-efficient separation techniques, including advanced distillation and hybrid methods, for the extraction of ethanol from a 95% azeotropic mixture.

clarification_questions: What is the composition of the azeotropic mixture besides ethanol?
Are there any constraints on the separation process, such as temperature or pressure limitations?
What is the desired purity of the extracted ethanol?
